content: We have an issue category for intentions which is aimed to support https://github.com/leanprover-community/project-intentions/issues. But Claude tells me that these are only enforced upon TauCeti workers if the roadmap labels are applied correctly, which they are only 4 of the 29 open issues. I don't have permission to edit labels, so I think this needs help from @Kim Morrison or @Chris Birkbeck .
Ah, I was wrong and I do have permission to edit labels. This still needs to be done for many of these intentions....
And many of the new roadmap labels need to be created (or the mechanism needs to be adjusted, now that the number of roadmaps is drastically increasing).
Can you expand a bit more? I tried to make the tool work well for humans, and it seems it did, are tou saying it is misaligned with what TauCeti needs?

I looked into this a bit, and have just fixed the issue at https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiWorker/pull/383. If anyone is running a worker, you should update it so that your worker respects intentions going forward (@Kim Morrison updated the labels, so existing workers should be okay for a while, but won't respect new claims until they're updated).

This bug does seem to have had an impact; I'm still looking into details.
